notes.title: Onion Force Update v1.1
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce Onion Force has received an update! We believe the changes greatly improve the players experience. 

Some of the most notable changes include:

Gameplay Updates
-   Character movement moved to left analog stick
-   Aiming ranged attacks moved to the right analog stick
-   Fire ranged attack added to the right trigger
-   Zoom in and zoom out moved to up and down on the d-pad
-   Magnetic force applied to players that collects coins and onions as the 
      player walks by
-   Haptic feedback added when player gets damaged

   Bug Fixes
-   Fixed a bug where game crashes when selecting a locked power-up with 
    the controller
-   Fixed a bug where a window prompt appears when unlocking the energy 
    ball power-up
-   Fixed a bug where the tutorial text would refer to the wrong control 
    scheme 

To celebrate the update, Onion Force will be on sale starting tomorrow at 10 a.m. PST! 

We would love to hear your feedback, feel free to leave a review and let us know how you like the improvements. 

Also please leave us any feedback in the discussion page if you have and further suggestions.


Enjoy!

notes.title: Update coming Friday, back up your save files!
notes.notes:
On Friday at 10 PST,  we are going to be updating Onion Force. Please be sure to back-up your save files, just in case. We are still working on this issue of saves being wiped, so for now we will be sure to make all aware if we are performing an update so none of your hardwork/play will be lost.

Thank you all for your continued support, and your patience as we continue to make Onion Force even more awesome!
